source_excerpt: Some anime villains are easy to hate. Others are difficult to even look at. They might have a disturbing appearance, an unsettling smile or a habit of doing things that no normal person would consider. And sometimes, the scariest character in a series is not even the strongest one.Think about Shou Tucker and what he did to Nina, or the way Johan Liebert can ruin someone's life without raising a hand. These characters bring a different kind of horror to anime. Here are 10 villains whose actions and personalities can genuinely get under your skin.1. Orochimaru (Naruto)Orochimaru was one of the first villains in Naruto who genuinely felt like a horror character. His pale skin, snake-like eyes and unsettling smile made even his early appearances uncomfortable. He also had a habit of getting far too close to his opponents, almost as if he enjoyed watching them panic.But his experiments make him much worse. Orochimaru becomes obsessed with immortality and spends years experimenting on people to find ways to extend his life and acquire new abilities. His interest in Sasuke's body also leads him to target the young ninja as a potential vessel. With his ability to shed his skin and survive attacks that should kill him, Orochimaru is the kind of villain you would never want to meet. 2. Shou Tucker (Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood)If there is one character who made anime fans uncomfortable without needing a terrifying appearance, it is Shou Tucker. He is a State Alchemist who works on human-animal chimeras. When his career comes under threat, he makes a decision that is difficult to forgive.Tucker uses his own daughter, Nina, and their dog, Alexander, to create a chimera. Nina has no idea what her father is planning. She simply trusts him. That makes the reveal even more heartbreaking. Tucker's experiment is still one of the most disturbing scenes in Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood3. Johan Liebert (Monster)Johan does not look like a dangerous person. He is polite, well-spoken and usually calm. You could easily mistake him for an ordinary young man. But spend enough time watching Monster and that first impression disappears.He has a frightening ability to understand people and use their weaknesses against them. Johan can push someone towards violence with just a few words. He does not need to stand in front of his victims with a weapon. Sometimes, he only needs to talk. That is what makes him so unsettling.4. Makima (Chainsaw Man)Denji has had a difficult life, so when Makima offers him food, a place to stay and some affection, he has every reason to trust her. She appears calm and caring, especially compared with the devils he usually faces.But Makima's friendly behaviour hides something much darker. As the Control Devil, she has the ability to dominate others and uses that power to manipulate people around her. Her treatment of Denji is particularly cruel because she knows exactly how much he wants a normal life. She uses that desire to keep him close. 5. Mahito (Jujutsu Kaisen)Mahito has a habit of smiling at the worst possible moments. His stitched appearance is already unsettling, but his cursed technique makes him much worse. Through Idle Transfiguration, he can reshape a person's soul and change their body.He uses this ability on ordinary humans, turning them into grotesque creatures. And he does not seem particularly bothered by their suffering. Mahito often treats his victims like toys rather than people. His casual attitude towards murder makes him one of the creepiest characters in Jujutsu Kaisen. 6. Tomura Shigaraki (My Hero Academia)Those severed hands covering Shigaraki's body are difficult to forget. Even before viewers understand his abilities, his appearance gives off an uncomfortable feeling. Then comes his Quirk, Decay, which allows him to destroy whatever he touches.Shigaraki becomes the leader of the League of Villains and a major threat to Japan's heroes. His childhood also reveals the trauma behind his hatred. His past does not excuse his actions, but it helps explain how he became someone who wants to destroy the society around him. 7. Petelgeuse RomanÃ©e-Conti (Re:Zero)Petelgeuse is the sort of character who makes you uncomfortable as soon as he enters a scene. He twitches, screams and moves in ways that are difficult to predict. Even his expressions can be unsettling.As the Sin Archbishop of Sloth, he follows the Witch's Cult and shows an extreme devotion to the Witch of Envy. His Invisible Hands let him attack without his opponents seeing what is coming. Add his disturbing idea of love to the mix, and you have one of the strangest villains in Re:Zero. 8. Hisoka Morow (Hunter x Hunter)Hisoka looks like a clown, but his behaviour is far from funny. He enjoys fighting strong opponents and often treats dangerous battles as entertainment. His strange interest in Gon and other young fighters makes his character even more uncomfortable to watch.There is also no telling which side Hisoka will take. He can help the main characters when it suits him and become their enemy when he finds a better opportunity. That unpredictable nature is a big part of what makes him so creepy. 9. Hand Demon (Demon Slayer)The Hand Demon looks like something Tanjiro should never have encountered during his training. Its enormous body is covered in arms, and its appearance is enough to make the encounter frightening.But its history makes things worse. The demon has a particular hatred for Sakonji Urokodaki and targets the students he sends to Final Selection on Mount Fujikasane. It has killed several of them before Tanjiro arrives. When Tanjiro learns about its connection to his mentor, the fight becomes much more personal. 10. Ryuk (Death Note)Ryuk is not exactly the villain who spends every episode chasing the main character. In fact, he often looks like he is simply enjoying the show. Bored with the Shinigami world, he drops his Death Note into the human world, where Light Yagami eventually finds it.As Light starts killing people with the notebook, Ryuk watches without much concern. He does not try to stop the deaths or question Light's decisions. He is simply curious to see what happens next.
